source.name: OpenStreetMap contributors
source.geometryType: Continuous directed OSM public-road route to an external campus driveway junction. White-plate scooter uses mapped surface roads and dedicated park scooter lanes; no expressway, motorway or private-campus segment.
limitations: Coordinates and road connectivity are from OSM; not an engineering survey.
Viaduct OSM way is the centerline of the whole three-lane bidirectional deck, not a separately mapped southbound carriageway. Small lateral lane alignment is a rendering approximation.
Two southbound viaduct lanes are a morning-prototype allocation; OSM total lanes=3 must not be read as three southbound lanes. Current lane-control signs require field verification.
Bridge elevations of 7m and 100m ramps are visual assumptions. No measured vertical profile is supplied.
Signal timing, lane widths, traffic demand and building facade designs remain prototype assumptions.
White-plate scooter stays on surface as supported by council records. Current detailed signs and morning wastewater-plant diversion have not been fully reproduced.
Surface lane count is updated from the 2026 city completion announcement, but OSM centerline and intersection geometry may lag that work.

The arrival node is a mapped public-road/driveway junction outside the company campus. A staffed gate position, permitted visitor entrance, and current entrance control are not independently verified.
OSM node/way turn restrictions and one-way direction were checked. Unmapped signs, scooter two-stage-turn waiting boxes, temporary traffic orders and signal phases require field verification.
New two-way road lane counts use directional tags where present, otherwise half the tagged total as an explicit assumption; missing tags remain null.
Station values are true traveled meters for each vehicle. Use bikeStationMappings or the vehicle-specific path/intersections after splits and rejoins.
source.correction: Expanded to a complete route from the named public departure junction to the named company public-road driveway junction, with a separate white-plate scooter path.
